name: pl.kiedysport/sport
title: KiedySport.pl
description: When is the match? Ticketed sports events in Poland: volleyball, MMA, hockey. Read-only.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming ticketed sports events in Poland listed on KiedySport.pl: league and national team matches, tournaments, MMA and boxing nights. Filters (all optional, combine freely): discipline, city, club, venue, date_from/date_to or a `when` shortcut, free-text query. Returns up to 20 events per call (page with offset and next_offset) with date, start time or "wkrótce", venue, city, price from (only when known) and the event page link, plus total_found. Default range: from today on. Example call: {"discipline":"mma-boks"} or {"city":"Katowice","discipline":"mma-boks"}. / Szukaj meczów i gal z biletami: dyscyplina, miasto (także bez polskich znaków), klub, hala, daty, fraza.

discipline.description: Sport slug (see list_disciplines). Names like "volleyball", "siatkówka", "MMA" are accepted too. / Dyscyplina.

city.description: Polish city, with or without Polish letters, e.g. "Kraków" or "Krakow". / Miasto.

club.description: Club or team name, short forms accepted (e.g. "Stal Mielec" for "Handball Stal Mielec"). / Klub.

venue.description: Arena, hall or stadium name. / Hala lub stadion.

when.description: Date shortcut (Europe/Warsaw); this_weekend = Friday to Sunday of the current week. Overrides date_from/date_to.

query.description: Words from the event title, team or venue, e.g. "KSW", "Puchar Polski". / Fraza.

offset.description: Skip this many matches; use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One sports event on KiedySport.pl by its id (slug from search_events or club_schedule) or page URL: date, weekday, start time or "wkrótce" (not announced yet), venue with address, teams, price from (only when the seller published it), official ticket seller links and the event page link. Example call: {"id":"tauron-superpuchar-polski-gks-tychy-jkh-gks-jastrzebie-tychy-2026-11-24"}. / Szczegóły jednego wydarzenia: termin, godzina, hala z adresem, cena od, link do sprzedawcy.

tools.name: club_schedule
tools.description: Next matches with tickets of one club or team listed on KiedySport.pl (home and away), sorted by date. Short and colloquial names work (e.g. "Stal Mielec", "Jastrzębie", "Gieksa"), with or without Polish letters. Required: `club`. Example call: {"club":"GKS Tychy"}. / Najbliższe mecze klubu z biletami.

club.description: Club or team name. / Nazwa klubu.

tools.name: list_disciplines
tools.description: Sports on KiedySport.pl with the number of upcoming events, Polish and English names, the slug to pass as `discipline` to search_events and the sport page link. No arguments; example call: {}. / Lista dyscyplin z liczbą wydarzeń.
